subject: [PATCH 1/3] mm: page_alloc: add a watermark check that knows the migratetype

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the __zone_watermark_ok() function in the Linux kernel's memory management (mm) module to take into account the migratetype of a page allocation request. The function is split into two separate functions: __zone_watermark_ok_mt(), which takes the migratetype as an argument, and __zone_watermark_ok(), which is a wrapper around it for checks that don't need to know the migratetype. This change allows the kernel to accurately determine whether there is enough free memory available for an allocation request, even when the request can only take pages of its own migratetype or claim a whole free block.
